name: expenses
description: Expense Tracker: Brett's ledger, pay schedule, reports and AI assistant (Next.js), ported from MossesX/Expense
notes: Imported Nov 4 2026 with its history (git subtree, build expenses-port). Runs on its own vendored @axf/core 0.0.25 copy (the earlier studio line), not the AXF engines yet, so framework.relation is 'for' and its UI is held to a shrink-only conformance baseline (framework/spec/conform-baseline.json). Data lives on the Docker volume amberx-studio-data (shared with studio.amberxai.com), never in the repo. MossesX/Expense is left as is.
